reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the 'Every batch lab-tested' line with the QR, which is more proof than most brands give, but $29.99 a month for magnesium is still a lot on my budget when a bottle at the drugstore is way cheaper. I'd maybe scan the QR out of curiosity, not buy.
objection: I can't tell if a QR report is worth $30 a month when plain magnesium costs a fraction of that, and a creator video isn't proof it does anything for my sleep.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $18 for the month, or a cheap trial size so I can see if it does anything before committing.
